description:
The Albuquerque Area Office (AAO) Indian Health Service (IHS) is issuing a Request for Information (RFI) notice for informational and planning purposes only. This notice shall not be construed as a solicitation, obligation, or commitment by the Government. This notice is intended strictly for market research to determine if requirements can be met through a 100% Set-Aside for Small Business concerns.

Purpose: The purpose of this notice is to identify qualified sources and their size classifications/socioeconomic status. This is a Request for Information (RFI) only. It is not a solicitation for proposals, proposal abstracts, or quotations.

Requirements:

  • NAICS Code: 334516
  • NAICS Code Description: Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing
  • To provide urinalysis testing system with reagents, consumables, and cost-per-reportable service for the Laboratory department at Zuni Comprehensive Community Health Center (ZCCHC).

(Similar NAICS code will be considered. Interested vendors proposing an alternate NAICS code shall submit a detailed explanation demonstrating how the proposed NAICS code aligns with and more accurately represents the principal purpose of this requirement)

Instructions for Respondents-Interested parties are invited to submit responses that include the following information:

  1. SAM Registration
    • Confirmation of registration and certification in the System for Award Management (SAM) at https://sam.gov.
  2. Company Information
    • Company name, address, and point of contact.
    • Unique Entity ID (UEI) number.
    • Size of business under the identified NAICS code.
  3. Socioeconomic Status
    • Identify whether your business qualifies as:
      • Indian Small Business Economic Enterprise (ISBEE)
      • Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB)
      • Woman-Owned Small Business (WOSB)
      • Other Small Business categories
  4. Capability Statement
    • Provide a capability statement, product brochure, or relevant performance information demonstrating your ability to provide the required services.
  5. ISBEE Representation Form
    • Complete and submit the Indian Small Business Economic Enterprise (ISBEE) representation form.

Important Notes:

  • Responses to this notice will be used by the Government to inform acquisition strategy.
  • Interested parties must respond to any solicitation announcement separately from this RFI notice.
  • Submit your information to Shannon Eldridge-Shorty via e-mail: shannon.eldridge-shorty@ihs.gov, May 18, 2026,  by 12:00 PM (MT). 
  • Automated responses or other responses that do not provide the requested information specified in this Sources Sought Notice will be noted as non-responsive and not considered in this Market Research.
